## About me

Currently work for an AEC solutions company called BHC LLP, I specialize in deep learning workflows that help solve GIS related problems for municipalities around North Texas and my research focuses mainly on creating deep learning packages for asset management with a focus on drone imagery.

Before starting my PhD, I earned my M.S. in Geospatial Information Sciences form UTD, where I learned to create 3D visualizations alongside my maps using many of the tools developed by the leading provider of GIS software ESRI.

## Research

My current research focuses on:

- **Pixel Classification of Distress Features** — Leveraging the tools built into ArcGIS Pro, making classifiers for different distress features (i.e potholes, linear cracking, alligator cracking) in asphalt roads.
- **Object Detection and Water Modeling** — Connecting existing GIS hydrology related layers to form 3D models that can accurately display anomalies in an intuitive way.
